I've written the evaluator in TypeScript under `src/`. `build.sh` creates `./app`, a small launcher that runs the code with Node directly, so there is no separate compile step. `node check.mjs` passes all 6 example cases.

- **64-bit limits:** `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives `0`. Dividing that same value by `-1` gives `error`.
